② Leave a 2–3 finger gap behind your knees.

slides.title: Still sore after the tweaks?
slides.bubble:
Causes differ for everyone.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Mr Turtle bought a fancy chair and his back still grumbles. Turns out he'd never touched a single lever.

Five minutes is enough. Feet flat, knees about level with your hips. Sit right back so the backrest shares the work, and pop a rolled-up towel behind your lower back if there's no lumbar support. Drop the armrests so your shoulders can relax.

Then the bit most people skip: no chair is comfy for eight hours straight. Stand for calls and walk to refill your water.

Tingling down a leg or pain that builds as you sit is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🪑
